class.name: mujoco_ros2_control_examples/TouchGridSensor
class.description: Publishes a mujoco.sensor.touch_grid tactile array as a std_msgs/Float64MultiArray instead of exporting state interfaces. Example of a MujocoRos2PluginInterface plugin living outside mujoco_ros2_control, declared as a top-level <mujoco_ros2_plugin> element.

class.name: mujoco_ros2_control_examples/BodyServices
class.description: Serves mujoco_get_body_state and mujoco_set_body_pose: reads a body's world pose and twist, and teleports a body with a single free joint. Once built into the simulation node, then shipped by mujoco_ros2_control; an example plugin now, bringing its own service definitions with it.
